The man behind the mic

Professional when it matters.
Funny when it counts.

Because your guests deserve an unforgettable event — not a meeting that accidentally got decorated.

MC Sheikh, professionally known as Ibrahim Khalil Maidaula, brings together two skills that rarely behave this well together: premium event execution and comedy-driven crowd control.

From Kano to Abuja and beyond, his approach is simple: understand the room, respect the occasion, keep the programme moving and make people laugh without turning your wedding, conference or celebration into a circus.

Fluent in English and Hausa, with the cultural flexibility to connect across Nigerian audiences, MC Sheikh can take the brief, take the microphone and — if necessary — take a flight. Worldwide availability included.
